newsitem.title: MEXICO: TMM to invest $22 mln in Acapulco port.
newsitem.headline: TMM to invest $22 mln in Acapulco port.

text.p: Mexican transportation firm Transportacion Maritima Mexicana said on Thursday that it would invest $22 million in the second phase of an improvement of the port at Acapulco.

"The total investment will be $22 million, and its operation will mean 1,180 permanent jobs," Jose Serrano Segovia, chairman of the TMM board, said in a ceremony at this Pacific resort during a visit by President Ernesto Zedillo.
The first phase of the Acapulco port improvement, also awarded to TMM, was completed at a cost of $7.4 million.
The second phase of the project aims to upgrade the passenger terminal as the Acapulco port is used mostly for tourism rather than shipping.
